messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "wait at least 2 weeks after stopping an MAOI before starting fluoxetine"
set: ["wait at least 2 weeks after stopping an MAOI before starting fluoxetine", "wait at least 5 weeks after stopping fluoxetine before starting an MAOI or thioridazine", "wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "stopping fluoxetine", "4 weeks after starting", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "children tested 2 and 4 weeks after starting treatment", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "stop using at least 2 months before planning to get pregnant", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "This applies to patients taking 300 mg/day for at least 2 weeks", "ask doctor before stopping", "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
